headline: Execution is not the fix: cheaper limit entries fill the losers and miss the runners, and no cost-killed setup is net positive as traded. That flips into one new test - entering only once price confirms.
bullets: Limit entries at the signal price (LIMEX, 0 of 3): the trades they miss earn +0.22R, the ones they fill -0.07R.
Cost-killed setups: live paper costs are ~1/3 of the lab charge, but only 2 of 17 stay positive without their best day, and both depend on one short-friendly window.
Unexplained gaps (no news, no sector move) closed: they drift with the gap, not against it, and the pilot's line was the opposite sign.
Next: one counted confirmation-entry test (CONFIRM); a 'what works' list of live setups positive after costs and without their best day; a 3-day synthesis for the owner.
FAMC first reaction session is today (ALC, RGTI).
next: CONFIRM plan + Skeptic attack; Scout's what-works list; Observer's 3-day synthesis; FAMC nightly.
